description:
CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: mwifiex_set_uap_rates() memcpy's rate_ie->len bytes from the SUPP_RATES and EXT_SUPP_RATES IEs into the fixed-size bss_cfg->rates (at offset rate_len for the second) without checking against MWIFIEX_SUPPORTED_RATES, overflowing the buffer.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: mp_dss_print() reads mdss->flags and then the ack/seq/subseq/len/csum fields via EXTRACT_*BITS(opt) without checking remaining opt_len before each field, relying on the mp_dss_len() comparison, so a malformed MPTCP DSS option can cause reads beyond the option buffer.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: In asepcos_parse_sec_attr() the length check `len < 5 && p[0] != 0x80 && p[1] != 0x01` uses && instead of ||, so short remaining input is not rejected and p[2]..p[5] are read beyond the end of buf.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance: In ReluPrepare, the results of GetInput and GetOutput are used without a NULL check: input->type is read and output is passed to CalculateReluOpData even when the tensor lookup returned nullptr.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance: In Prepare(), the results of GetInput()/GetOutput() (input, output) are not checked for nullptr before being passed to CalculateOpData and dereferenced via input->type, so a model with an invalid or optional tensor index causes a null pointer dereference.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance: In TanhPrepare, the tensor returned by GetInput(context, node, kInputTensor) is dereferenced (input->params.zero_point) without checking for nullptr, so a model with an invalid or optional input index causes a null pointer dereference.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: rose_loopback_timer() reads skb->data[0..2] and the dest address at skb->data+4 (and passes the frame on for call-request parsing) without checking skb->len against ROSE_MIN_LEN or the call-request facilities offset, allowing out-of-bounds reads on short frames.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: rose_route_frame() reads skb->data header bytes and src/dest addresses and passes skb->data + len + 4 (len derived from attacker-controlled data[3]) to rose_parse_facilities without ever checking skb->len, allowing out-of-bounds reads on short or malformed frames.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance: In processBatchMultiRuleset(), the temporary batch snglRuleBatch allocated by batchInit() is never freed because the loop exits only via FINALIZE to finalize_it, skipping the unreachable batchFree(&snglRuleBatch).

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2011-2789): PPB_Widget_Impl::Invalidate() dereferences instance()->module() without checking whether instance() is NULL, which it is when the widget resource outlives its destroyed plugin instance.

CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')
This instance (CVE-2017-5940): copy_xauthority() checks is_link(dest) early, but after the unprivileged child copies the file the root parent runs chown(dest)/chmod(dest), which follow a path the user can swap for a symlink, so root changes ownership/permissions of an arbitrary file (TOCTOU symlink race).

CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')
This instance (CVE-2017-5940): copy_asoundrc() checks is_link(dest) and then, as root, calls chown(dest)/chmod(dest) on a path in the user's home after the child copy, so the user can replace dest with a symlink in between and have root chown/chmod an arbitrary file.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2024-40130): In app_initialize(), the loop over argv copies entries into the fixed-size stack array argv_out[OGS_ARG_MAX] without bounding i, so excess arguments (plus the appended "-c", default config and NULL) write past the end of argv_out.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-1010223): new_aubio_tempo() copies the caller-controlled tempo_mode string into the fixed 20-byte stack buffer specdesc_func with strcpy() and no length check, causing a stack buffer overflow for long mode strings.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2013-4160): OptimizeMatrixShaper() passes the unchecked results of cmsStageDup(Curve1/Curve2) and cmsStageAllocMatrix() to cmsPipelineInsertStage(), so an allocation failure yields a NULL stage that is dereferenced when linked into the pipeline.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: memcpy copies wcslen(data)*sizeof(wchar_t) bytes (99 wide chars) from the 100-element source into the 50-element stack buffer dest without checking the size, overflowing dest.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8 (before the start of the alloca'd buffer) and the copy loop writes data[i] for i in 0..99, writing before the buffer's start (buffer underwrite).

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8, and memmove(data, source, 100*sizeof(wchar_t)) then writes before the start of the stack array dataBuffer (buffer underwrite).

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: The index `data` read from stdin via fscanf is checked only for being non-negative, not for `data < 10`, before `buffer[data]` is read, allowing an out-of-bounds read past the 10-element stack array.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8, so the copy loop reading data[i] into dest reads memory before the start of the stack-allocated dataBuffer (buffer under-read).

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8 (before the start of the malloc'd buffer) and memmove(dest, data, 100) reads 8 bytes before the allocation, a buffer under-read.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance: The buffer allocated with realloc into data in process_68() is never freed: the second globalReturnsTrue() branch is an empty statement where free(data) belongs, so the memory leaks on return.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance: The buffer allocated with realloc() in do_work_39() and stored via dataPtr1 is never freed in the sink block that reads it through dataPtr2, leaking the memory.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance: The buffer `data` allocated with malloc(100*sizeof(wchar_t)) in load_entry_15() is never freed: the second staticReturnsTrue() block is empty, so the memory leaks.

CWE-908: Use of Uninitialized Resource
This instance: The stack buffer data allocated via ALLOCA(10*sizeof(double)) is never initialized, and its elements data[i] are read and printed via printDoubleLine in the loop.

CWE-416: Use After Free
This instance (CVE-2021-36144): virtio_rpmb_deinit() frees dev->arg (the virtio_rpmb device) without first calling virtio_rpmb_reset() to stop the virtio polling timer, so the still-armed timer handler later accesses the freed device.

CWE-416: Use After Free
This instance (CVE-2019-15920): SMB2_read() frees req with cifs_small_buf_release(req) immediately after cifs_send_recv() and then dereferences req->PersistentFileId in the trace_smb3_read_err/trace_smb3_read_done calls.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-14816): mwifiex_update_vs_ie() memcpy's vs_ie->len + 2 bytes of a user-supplied vendor IE into ie->ie_buffer at offset ie->ie_length without checking that ie_length + vs_ie->len + 2 stays within IEEE_MAX_IE_SIZE, overflowing the heap buffer.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-14816): mwifiex_set_wmm_params() memcpy()s into bss_cfg->wmm_info using the attacker-controlled IE length byte *(wmm_ie + 1) without checking it against sizeof(struct mwifiex_types_wmm_info), overflowing the heap-allocated bss_cfg.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2019-16754): _on_unsuback() casts req->arg to sub and dereferences it (sub->next, sub->topic) without checking for NULL, so a spoofed UNSUBACK matching a pending non-subscribe request's message ID causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2019-16754): _on_suback_timeout() casts req->arg to asymcute_sub_t* and writes sub->topic = NULL without checking for NULL, so a request matched by a spoofed msgid with a NULL arg crashes the node.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2023-0122): In nvmet_setup_auth(), after nvme_auth_extract_key() fails for dhchap_ctrl_secret, ctrl->ctrl_key is set to NULL without jumping to out_free_hash, so the following pr_debug dereferences ctrl->ctrl_key->hash/len/key on a NULL pointer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-47021): op_get_data() passes the result of ogg_sync_buffer() to the read callback without checking it for NULL, so an allocation failure leads to a NULL pointer dereference when data is read into the buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-47021): In op_open1(), the buffer returned by ogg_sync_buffer() is passed to memcpy() without a NULL check, so an allocation failure leads to a null pointer dereference.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2016-7161): eth_rx() memcpy's the received packet of length size into &s->regs[rxbase + R_RX_BUF0] without checking size against the remaining space in the regs array, so a large packet overflows the heap buffer.

CWE-908: Use of Uninitialized Resource
This instance (CVE-2016-9756): em_jmp_far() fills old_sel/old_desc via get_segment only in 64-bit mode, but when assign_eip_far fails in another mode it passes these uninitialized stack variables to ops->set_segment for CS, leaking host kernel stack data to the guest.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2016-0546): print_arrays_for() calls sprintf(buf, "%s.conf", set) with no length bound, so a long `set` name overflows the fixed-size global buffer `buf`.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2015-8630): In kadm5_modify_principal(), when mask includes KADM5_POLICY, entry->policy is passed to get_policy() and strdup() without checking that it is non-NULL, so a remote client supplying a NULL policy name causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2010-1084): rfcomm_sock_sysfs_show() appends a line per socket in rfcomm_sk_list to the one-page sysfs buf with unbounded sprintf and no PAGE_SIZE limit, so a large number of sockets overflows the buffer.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2010-1084): sco_sysfs_show() appends one line per SCO socket into the PAGE_SIZE sysfs buffer with unbounded sprintf(str, ...), so many sockets overflow the page.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2011-1163): osf_partition() loops up to the unvalidated on-disk label->d_npartitions while advancing the partition pointer, reading past the 8-entry d_partitions array and leaking heap memory via put_partition.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-34967): rel_order_by_column_exp() descends from a processed simple projection with `r = r->l` without checking that `r->l` is non-NULL, so for single-row projections `r` becomes NULL and is then used (e.g. `r->card` in the GROUP BY check loop).

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2017-6209): The while loop in parse_identifier writes ret[i++] = *cur++ for every alphanumeric/underscore character with no bound on i, overflowing the caller's fixed-size stack buffer ret when given a long identifier.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2017-6429): In main(), the attacker-controlled packet caplen from the pcap header is passed to read(fd, &buf, caplen) into the fixed 10000-byte stack buffer buf without bounding it to sizeof(buf), causing a stack buffer overflow.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2017-9204): get_exif_tag_int_value() reads e->d[tag_pos+2], e->d[tag_pos+4] and e->d[tag_pos+8] via iw_get_ui16_e/iw_get_ui32_e without checking the offsets against the Exif buffer length, allowing an out-of-bounds read with crafted Exif tag positions.

CWE-416: Use After Free
This instance (CVE-2022-3016): When an autocmd run from qf_jump_open_window() frees or changes the location list, qf_jump_newwin() still goes to theend with qi non-NULL and writes qfl->qf_ptr/qf_index into the freed qf_list_T.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2018-14017): In r_bin_java_local_variable_type_table_attr_new, the loop over the file-controlled table_length reads 10 bytes per entry via R_BIN_JAVA_USHORT(buffer, offset) without checking offset against sz, causing a heap buffer over-read.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2023-5972): nft_inner_init() calls nla_get_be32(tb[NFTA_INNER_NUM]) without first checking that tb[NFTA_INNER_NUM] is non-NULL, so a netlink request omitting that attribute causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2023-27600): In delete_sdp_line(), end is unconditionally incremented after the scan loop even when it stopped at stream->body.s+body.len without finding '\n', so the range passed to del_lump extends one byte past the SDP body/message buffer.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2023-1452): In gf_text_get_utf8_line() the conversion loop writes to the 2048-byte stack array szLineConv[j] without checking j against the buffer size, so long lines or high-bit-character expansion overflow the stack buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2020-23258): jsi_ArrayReduceSubCmd computes maa from fptr->argnames (0 for builtin callbacks) and may put NULL in vobjs[2], so the builtin callback gets a short or NULL-containing argument array and dereferences a NULL argument value (e.g. in Jsi_ValueIsNumber).

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2023-31568): PdfEncryptRC4 constructor memcpy's a fixed 32 bytes from oValue.GetRawData().data() and uValue.GetRawData().data() without checking that the /O and /U strings are at least 32 bytes, causing a heap out-of-bounds read.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2017-9740): In the cmap format 4 case, the pointers idRangeOffset (derived from untrusted segCount2) and idRangeOffset + i2 + roff + ((i - start) << 1) are dereferenced via u16() without checking them against font->data + font->length, causing a heap buffer over-read.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2022-0359): In init_ccline(), Ex mode allocates cmdbuff with a fixed 250 bytes regardless of indent, so vim_memset(ccline.cmdbuff, ' ', indent) and ccline.cmdbuff[indent] = NUL overflow the heap buffer when indent is large (e.g. a large 'tabstop').

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2015-7673): parse_rle_data_pseudocolor() indexes ctx->cmap->cols[*s] with an attacker-controlled pixel byte without checking it against the colormap size, reading past the heap-allocated colormap in both the RLE and raw packet paths.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2006-7203): In compat_sys_mount(), data_page can be NULL (0) when no mount data is supplied, yet it is passed unchecked to do_smb_super_data_conv/do_ncp_super_data_conv/do_nfs4_super_data_conv, which dereference it.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2008-1514): In __poke_user_compat(), an addr in the padding between regs.orig_gpr2 and regs.fp_regs reaches the fp_regs branch, where offset = addr - &dummy32->regs.fp_regs underflows and the write *(__u32 *)(&child->thread.fp_regs + offset) = tmp goes out of bounds.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2019-12108): In GetOutboundPinholeTimeout(), the argument check tests ext_port instead of rem_port, so a request missing RemotePort leaves rem_port NULL and it is dereferenced by atoi(rem_port).

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2008-2812): x25_asy_timeout() calls the optional tty operation sl->tty->driver->chars_in_buffer without checking it is non-NULL, causing a NULL function pointer call for tty drivers that do not implement it.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2008-2812): set_baud() invokes the optional tty->driver->set_termios function pointer without checking it for NULL, so a tty driver lacking set_termios causes a NULL function pointer call.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2008-2812): ax_xmit() calls ax->tty->driver->chars_in_buffer(ax->tty) on transmit timeout without checking whether the optional chars_in_buffer function pointer is NULL.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-25892): In PDFParser::ParseLastXrefPosition(), anObject returned by mObjectParser.ParseNewObject() is dereferenced via anObject->GetType() without checking for NULL, so a crafted PDF trailer that yields no object crashes the parser.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2020-7044): wassp_match_strval() uses `max_entry < in_type` instead of `<=`, so in_type equal to max_entry indexes in_ptr->entry[] one past its end, an off-by-one out-of-bounds read.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-9500): In brcmf_wowl_nd_results(), the firmware-supplied netinfo->SSID_len is used unchecked as the memcpy length into the 32-byte cfg->wowl.nd->ssid.ssid buffer, allowing a heap buffer overflow when it exceeds IEEE80211_MAX_SSID_LEN.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2020-25866): On revisited frames, decompress() dereferences saved_data (from p_get_proto_data) without a NULL check, but no data was saved because the first-pass inflate into the fixed BLIP_INFLATE_BUFFER_SIZE buffer failed and returned NULL early.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance (CVE-2018-9274): file_description is allocated by input_file_description() before the err check but only g_free'd in the err < 0 branch, so it leaks whenever err is non-negative.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-34520): oneshotall_buffer() appends the result of get_the_meta() to the returned list without checking it for NULL, so the caller r_bin_file_xtr_load_buffer dereferences a NULL RBinXtrData element.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2017-14505): DrawGetStrokeDashArray() writes through q (initialized from dasharray) without checking whether AcquireQuantumMemory() returned NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference on allocation failure.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2012-3364): nci_extract_rf_params_nfcf_passive_poll() copies sensf_res_len bytes, taken unchecked from the incoming frame, into the fixed-size nfcf_poll->sensf_res array via memcpy without clamping to NFC_SENSF_RES_MAXSIZE, overflowing it.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2022-2124): In current_quote(), the loop `while (i <= col_end)` scanning for quotechar indexes line[i] up to a column taken from the Visual/cursor positions without stopping at the line's NUL, so it reads past the end of the line buffer when the line was shortened after selection.

CWE-416: Use After Free
This instance (CVE-2013-4127): vhost_net_ubuf_put_and_wait() unconditionally calls kfree(ubufs) after waiting for the refcount to drop, while its caller vhost_net_flush() keeps using the ubufs object afterward, causing a use-after-free.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2014-2986): In the GICD_ICFGR+2..GICD_ICFGRN case of vgic_distr_mmio_write(), vgic_lock_rank(v, rank) dereferences the rank returned by vgic_irq_rank() before checking it for NULL, so a guest write to an out-of-range ICFGR register causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2014-3967): In hvm_inject_msi(), the pointer returned by pirq_info(d, pirq) for a guest-chosen pirq is dereferenced (info->arch.hvm.emuirq) and passed to send_guest_pirq() without a NULL check, though it is NULL for a non-allocated pIRQ and is not re-fetched after map_domain_emuirq_pirq().

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2020-16118): imap_mbox_connect() passes handle->last_msg to strncmp() without a NULL check, and it is NULL when the server greets with PREAUTH, which does not set last_msg.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2020-16269): get_die_name() calls strdup on die->attr_values[name_attr_idx].string.content without checking for NULL, which happens when a malformed DW_AT_name references an invalid .debug_str offset.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2020-16293): do_compose_group() selects compose_group_nonknockout_nonblend_isolated_allmask_common when maskbuf is non-NULL but maskbuf->data is NULL (has_mask false), passing a NULL mask_row_ptr that the callee dereferences.

CWE-416: Use After Free
This instance (CVE-2016-1635): OnDocumentElementCreated passes the raw context() ScriptContext pointer and the JS callback into a self-owned LoadWatcher, which later invokes the callback (possibly re-entrantly) after that ScriptContext may already have been destroyed, causing a use-after-free.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2016-4542): exif_process_TIFF_in_JPEG() reads the TIFF header values via php_ifd_get16u(CharBuf+2) and php_ifd_get32u(CharBuf+4) without checking that length >= 8, causing an out-of-bounds heap read on short EXIF data.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-11221): gf_bt_report() uses vsprintf() to format caller-supplied format/arguments (possibly containing parsed file strings) into the fixed 2048-byte stack buffer szMsg with no length limit, allowing a stack buffer overflow.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2011-1180): In iriap_getvaluebyclass_indication(), the peer-supplied name_len and attr_len bytes (up to 255) are passed to memcpy into the 60-byte stack arrays name[] and attr[], and used as the index for the NUL terminator, without any bound check, causing a stack buffer overflow.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2016-7115): In handle_packet(), the MT_CPTYPE_PASSSALT branch calls memcpy(pass_salt, cpkt.data, cpkt.length) using the server-controlled cpkt.length without checking it against the 16-byte pass_salt buffer, causing a buffer overflow.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2018-14017): In r_bin_java_line_number_table_attr_new the loop over the attacker-controlled line_number_table_length reads start_pc/line_number via R_BIN_JAVA_USHORT(buffer, offset) without checking offset against sz, causing a heap buffer over-read.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2021-31256): In the fast path where SampleToChunk->nb_entries equals SampleSize->sampleCount, stco->offsets[sampleNumber-1] and co64->offsets[sampleNumber-1] are read without checking sampleNumber against the chunk offset box's nb_entries, causing a heap out-of-bounds read.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-0419): In load_buffer() the beach error path unconditionally writes obj->cache_buf = NULL even though obj is NULL when prelink_range is missing or after R_FREE(obj), causing a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-9500): In brcmf_wowl_nd_results(), the firmware-controlled netinfo->SSID_len is used unchecked as the memcpy length into the 32-byte cfg->wowl.nd->ssid.ssid buffer, causing a heap buffer overflow when it exceeds IEEE80211_MAX_SSID_LEN.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-0393): delete_buff_tail() calls STRLEN(buf->bh_curr->b_str) without checking that buf->bh_curr is non-NULL (empty recording buffer), causing an invalid read when deleting the last recorded character in Select mode.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2022-25375): rndis_set_response() uses the attacker-controlled InformationBufferLength/InformationBufferOffset (BufLength/BufOffset) without validating them against RNDIS_MAX_TOTAL_SIZE, passing buf+8+BufOffset and BufLength to gen_ndis_set_resp and causing an out-of-bounds read of kernel memory.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2021-28660): In rtw_wx_set_scan(), the CSCAN SSID section's sec_len is checked only against the remaining input length (not the 32-byte ssid[] size), so memcpy(ssid[ssid_index].ssid, pos, sec_len) writes beyond the end of the ssid array.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-30975): jsP_dumpsyntax() dereferences prog->type without checking prog for NULL, which the parser returns for an empty program.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-19334): In make_canonical()'s LY_TYPE_IDENT case, sprintf(buf, "%s:%s", module_name, *value) and strcpy(buf, *value) copy an attacker-controlled identityref value into the fixed 512-byte stack buffer buf without checking its length against buf_len, overflowing the stack.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2022-1238): r_bin_ne_get_entrypoints() reads bin->entry_table at file-controlled offsets without bounds checks inside the inner bundle loop, and indexes bin->segment_entries[segnum - 1] (and [bundle_type - 1]) with an unvalidated file-supplied segnum (including 0), causing heap out-of-bounds reads.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2022-2124): In current_quote(), the loop `while (i <= col_end) if (line[i++] == quotechar)` scans up to the stale Visual/cursor column col_end without checking for the line's NUL terminator, reading past the end of the line buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2019-12615): get_vdev_port_node_info() assigns the result of kstrdup_const() to node_info->vdev_port.name without checking it for NULL and returns success, so a failed allocation leaves a NULL name that is later dereferenced.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2007-6063): isdn_net_setcfg() copies the user-supplied cfg->eaz into lp->msn with an unbounded strcpy, so a string that is too long or not NUL-terminated overflows lp->msn.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2015-7566): clie_5_attach() checks only serial->num_ports rather than the number of bulk-out endpoints, so on a device without bulk-out endpoints port->write_urbs[j] is NULL and port->write_urbs[j]->pipe = pipe dereferences a NULL pointer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2017-7274): r_pkcs7_parse_cms dereferences object->list.objects and object->list.objects[1] (via objects[1]->list.length) without checking either for NULL, so a crafted ASN.1 structure causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-14816): mwifiex_set_wmm_params() memcpy()s *(wmm_ie + 1) bytes, a user-controlled IE length, into the fixed-size bss_cfg->wmm_info without checking it against sizeof(bss_cfg->wmm_info), causing a heap buffer overflow.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2019-12818): nfc_llcp_build_gb() does not check the return values of nfc_llcp_build_tlv() (version_tlv, lto_tlv, wks_tlv, miux_tlv) for NULL before passing them as sources to memcpy into local->gb, causing a NULL pointer dereference on allocation failure.

CWE-416: Use After Free
